title: Human Evaluation of Creative NLG Systems: An Interdisciplinary Survey on Recent Papers

bias_targets.methodology: Surveying recent creative NLG papers to evaluate the lack of annotator demographic reporting, highlighting how unexamined crowd-sourced populations introduce subjective demographic biases.

Analyzing prior human evaluation results of poetry generation to demonstrate that texts generated in non-standard dialects score lower simply due to annotators' lack of familiarity with the dialect compared to standard Finnish.

Reviewing human evaluation setups in 23 NLP and Computational Creativity papers to identify vulnerabilities in how human annotators are recruited and sampled without proper statistical or demographic controls.
